values.note: $27 a single site; the group site (up to 25 people) $70 a night. Max 8 people per single site.

values.note: 21 non-electric single sites for tents, trailers and RVs, plus one reservable group site for up to 25. Rigs must fit on the parking spur. The forest's campground-status table lists Max Spur 50'.

values.note: A small corral for one or two horses (no water troughs); the Sulphur RD's only campground designated for horse camping. South Fork Trail starts at the campground.

note: Arapaho NF (Sulphur RD) campground in the Williams Fork Valley, ~8,940 ft: from US-40 two miles before Parshall take County Road 3 ~18 mi, then County Road 30 south 12 mi through a large culvert; the campground is a half-mile on. Next to South Fork Creek, in thinned lodgepole (beetle-kill removal has reduced shade). --Claude
summary: FS page + ARP status table + recreation.gov group listing: confirmed 21 sites, FCFS, $27, vault toilets, potable water. Added max vehicle 23 ft (FS + recreation.gov; status table says 50, flagged), no electric/water hookups, horse corral, season June 5 - Oct 11, group site $70 and reservable, fees checked 2026. Note rewritten: field facts dropped, directions added.
flags: Rig fit (CRITERIA, borderline): FS page 'Maximum Vehicle Length: 23''' and recreation.gov 'Maximum Vehicle Length is 23 feet.' EKKO is 23 ft, so it fits exactly with no margin. The forest's Sulphur RD campground-status table (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions) lists South Fork's Max Spur as 50', which conflicts; recorded the campground page's 23.

Website: stored https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation is the forest recreation index; the campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/south-fork-campground (group-site reservations: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/234211).
Phone missing: Sulphur Ranger District Office, 9 Ten Mile Drive, Granby, phone 970-295-6600 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/offices; the forest's shared number).

Horse camping (inclusion check): FS calls it 'the only campground on the Sulphur Ranger District that is designated for horse camping', but the facility is 21 ordinary single sites 'that will accommodate tents, trailers and RVs' with a small corral for one or two horses, so a general campground with a horse allowance, not a horse-only camp. Stored inclusion_evidence already reasons this way.
Toilets: FS says vault toilets; recreation.gov's group-site description says 'flush and pit toilets'. Kept vault_toilets true (FS).

Road: no agency wording on CR 3 / CR 30 surface; the old note's 'gravel access' had no source and was dropped. No 4WD/high-clearance wording. Closures: none for the campground. The Williams Fork Fire alert (August 20, 2026) closes only NFSR 140.3 and 141.1 and motorized trails M140-M142, not CR 30; the FS page's 'Site Closed' badge fits the Oct 11 season end.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront, kept; re-audit lead): recreation.gov says the campground is 'next to South Fork Creek'. On Esri imagery the creek runs along the loop's west edge ~20-35 m from the loop road, but entirely inside a dense conifer band, so no site has an open bank; the Williams Fork river meanders ~200 m north across CR 30.
Pin 39.7956,-106.0289 = the FS point, on the campground access road ~60-80 m east of the loop; fine. recreation.gov's group-site point 39.79405,-106.03063 is ~230 m SW, at the loop's south end.
